messages:
Dana: Quick scope huddle 0: We have two blocking asks from ACME: 1) 90-day telemetry retention for embeddings/latency metrics, 2) nearline embeddings (sub-2s upsert->query). If we do both GA slips by 3+ weeks. Thoughts?
Omar: High level: launch momentum > backlog features. We can normalize with ACME by offering a v1 commit for retention + nearline as "enterprise v1".
Elise: Eng reality: nearline embeddings need an async indexer + streaming upsert path + backpressure handling. Estimate: 3 sprints (indexer + hybrid cache + perf tuning). 90-day retention increases storage and aggregation cost but is primarily a billing/ops lift + retention compaction job (~1 sprint).
Rahul: Ops note 0: Nearline will raise write QPS and memory on embed workers; we saw latency tail regressions in canaries when input_len > 1024. Also long-retention metrics increase TSDB ingestion by ~2x. Finance: that doubles near-term infra spend if we commit.
Dana: Options:
- A: Keep GA date, implement short telemetry (7d), offline embeddings only (batch nightly), sell nearline + 90d retention as v1/enterprise add-on.
- B: Delay GA by 2-3 weeks to include 90d retention but defer nearline to v1.
- C: Delay GA 4+ weeks to include both.
Omar: Sales: ACME prefers A if we provide a clear charter for v1 and a pilot for nearline. They don't want the product delay.
Elise: Technically I prefer A too. Nearline is high-risk for GA; telemetry retention is easier to swing later (storage tiering).
product-bot: Reminder: Launch checklist requires "Telemetry SLO & cost estimate" entry before GA signoff.
deploy-bot: Canary: feature/nearline-embeddings branch failed at 2024-03-22T09:14:05Z 0: embed-indexer OOM on 1/3 workers (repro: stream-upsert x 50).
Elise: That canary fail reproduces the indexer mem blowup. Another reason to pilot nearline.
Dana: I'm leaning A. Short telemetry + batch embeddings for GA. We'll offer ACME a paid early-access pilot for nearline.
Omar: Vote check 0: A = ship GA with 7d telemetry + batch embeddings + nearline pilot, B = delay to add 90d, C = delay for both.
Elise: A :thumbsup:
Rahul: A :thumbsup: (Ops will provide caps and quotas for Pilot)
Omar: A :thumbsup: Sales will draft a pilot addendum.
Dana: Decision: Option A. Action items (put in PRD & launch board):
```
- Product: update PRD cutlist (short telemetry = 7 days), mark nearline embeddings & 90d retention as v1/enterprise features (owner: Dana, due: EOD)
- Eng: remove nearline feature flags from GA branch; stabilize batch embedding pipeline + add throttles (owner: Elise, due: next Tue)
- Ops/Finance: publish capacity delta & TSDB ingestion cost delta for 90d retention and Pilot Dedicated nodes (owner: Rahul, due: EOD)
- Sales/Legal: draft pilot agreement + pricing for nearline pilot (owner: Omar, due: tomorrow)
- Docs: FAQ and admin controls for telemetry retention & how to request Pilot (owner: Mei, due: EOD)
```
Dana: I'll post to #launch-comm and message ACME with the pilot offer.
Elise: Opening Pilot epic now and linking to this thread.
Rahul: Posting capacity delta shortly.
Omar: Looping legal.
Dana: Thanks team 680
